criteria.description: Any mission-ui screen hosted in the shell receives its data as real values (lists, objects), never as text.
criteria.evidence: packages/mission-shell/test/binding.test.ts (line 73) 'sets loadingMore as a property and leaves no attribute a wrong binding would create': the missions list is bound as a real array of the fixture items and loadingMore === true as a property; unit-tests plants 'binding: loadingMore not set as property' (registration order) red in the gate-proof leg

criteria.description: Every sk-* intent a hosted screen emits reaches the shell handler with its typed detail.
criteria.evidence: packages/mission-shell/test/binding.test.ts (line 124) 'delivers the declared events: one through real UI, the rest dispatched from the element': all declared intents from custom-elements.json, toHaveBeenCalledTimes(declared.length), sk-open-mission through a real click; unit-tests plant 'binding: intent sk-search not delivered'

criteria.description: FR-001 and FR-002 are verified by a permanent automated check on a real mission-ui screen, run on every pull request; a planted binding break makes it fail.
criteria.evidence: gates/plants/unit-tests/plant.json: 8 plants in all, 4 of them new in this mission (binding: loadingMore not set as property, binding: intent sk-search not delivered, coverage: missing operation getDriftReport, coverage: missing operation getNewThing), each red in the unit-tests proof leg; the binding checks run through the root test script (pnpm -r --no-bail) on every pull request

criteria.description: Shell code is type-checked against every screen declared properties and events, generated from the published declaration; a planted use of a non-existent property fails the type check.
criteria.evidence: scripts/typings.test.mjs line 177 'the real run types exactly the 15 elements of custom-elements.json and matches the committed file'; typecheck plants plantNoSuchProp (PlantProp.svelte) and open-misson (PlantIntent.svelte); manifest plant 'elements.d.ts is stale'

criteria.description: The repository holds a Rust workspace (shared core plus placeholder desktop and dashboard members) and the mission-shell package, all building from a clean checkout.
criteria.evidence: crates/kitty-core/tests/workspace.rs line 95 workspace_members_are_exactly_the_expected_packages; cargo build and cargo test --workspace --frozen in the rust gate; mission-shell typecheck (svelte-check --fail-on-warnings)

criteria.description: Every new check (Rust format, lint and tests; Svelte type check; declaration typings; lint, token-only style and data-driven rules extended to Svelte files) runs on every pull request inside the existing gate structure, each with a planted-defect proof.
criteria.evidence: 24 new plants, counted against merge-base 9c9d83c in gates/plants/*/plant.json: contract +3, data-driven +1, eslint +3, hygiene +4, manifest +1, no-io +1, rust +3, stylelint +1, typecheck +3, unit-tests +4 (21 at the pre-merge review, 24 after the landing folds); every proof leg ok, gate-proof coverage ok

criteria.description: The no-io gate covers mission-shell, and mission-ui keeps passing its no-io and data-driven gates unchanged; I/O planted in the shell fails the gate.
criteria.evidence: no-io plant 'no-io: fetch is forbidden (network I/O)' over PlantNoIo.svelte in packages/mission-shell/src; data-driven plant 'data-driven: S1 phase name or lane value as a literal' over PlantDataDriven.svelte; lint:no-io and lint:data-driven cover packages/*/src including .svelte

criteria.description: One client interface covers every read in the pinned contract, a change subscription, and a connection state with exactly the values connecting, connected, reconnecting, degraded: service-missing and degraded: contract-mismatch (amended 2026-10-15).
criteria.evidence: packages/mission-shell/test/port-coverage.test.ts line 85 'are exactly the five strings: connecting before first contact, then the four of the spec'; fixture-client.test.ts line 393 'starts connected (a documented test convenience), or in the initial state given, connecting included' and line 399 'notifies exactly once per change, for each of the five states'; resync tests at fixture-client.test.ts line 446 'still resynchronises an open subscription when a state listener throws' and line 493 'is delivered when the connection returns from reconnecting to connected, before any later change'. Amended 2026-10-15 (SO-DES-003, SO-DES-002)

criteria.description: A test fails, naming the read, when the pinned contract contains a read the client interface lacks.
criteria.evidence: packages/mission-shell/test/port-coverage.test.ts line 40 'covers exactly the operationIds of routes.json, naming any it lacks before anything else is checked (FR-009)'; unit-tests plants 'coverage: missing operation getDriftReport' (operation removed from the port) and 'coverage: missing operation getNewThing' (read added to routes.json), both red in the unit-tests leg

criteria.description: A local stub answers every read in the pinned contract with that operation vendored example, and a clear error for a read without an example.
criteria.evidence: crates/kitty-stub/tests/routes.rs every_read_serves_its_default_example (line 62), every_selectable_example_is_served_on_a_fitting_route (line 92, 57 examples), a_null_default_example_is_501 (line 264); crates/kitty-stub/tests/guard.rs Host, Origin and Forwarded 403 tests

criteria.description: The stub plays a scripted change sequence with at least one status transition, one lifecycle event and one log-truncated marker in a fixed order (stub resume added by the 2026-10-15 amendment).
criteria.evidence: crates/kitty-stub/tests/events.rs a_mission_scoped_stream_replays_changes_with_ids (64), an_unscoped_stream_carries_no_ids (97), the_stream_is_byte_identical_across_ten_runs (136), and the resume tests resuming_after_an_id_skips_that_item_and_every_item_before_it (214), an_unknown_cursor_resumes_after_the_last_log_truncated_item (246), last_event_id_resumes_exactly_like_stream_cursor (272), an_unscoped_or_empty_cursor_changes_nothing (299); scripts/contract/changes-json.test.mjs; fixture-client.test.ts 'a scoped subscription yields every change with the R2-05 cursors'. Resume added by the 2026-10-15 amendment (SO-DES-008)
